review: 1:2 שׁוֹמֵר עַד הַתָּמִים — 'keeping to the end' (the Arabic إِلَى التَّمَام); תָּמִים is the biblical 'complete/blameless', and the phrase reads as the promise of Phil 1:6 without quoting it.
3:1–3:2 יִהְיוּ מָתְנֵינוּ / אֲזוּרִים — 'let our loins be girded' (Luke 12:35, אֲזוּרֵי מָתְנַיִם); the Arabic أَحْقَاؤُنَا مُمَنْطَقَة is that verse, and אָזַר is the biblical verb for girding.
3:4 בַּתִּקְוָה בְטוּחִים — 'secure in hope'; the Arabic وَاثِقَة is 'confident', and בָּטוּחַ is the adjective of Ps 112:7's confident heart.
